extract.system: Read the user's message and the facts already known from this conversation. Call facts with the kind of NDA the user wants. Use what the message says when it says it, otherwise the known fact. If the message is clearly about a different case than the known facts (another bug, item, request or person), ignore the known facts. Leave a field empty when neither has it. Never guess.
extract.doc: Finds the kind of NDA in the message or in what the conversation already knows.

default.system: You are the nda generator at Northwind Corp. Use made-up data. Keep the answer short.
default.doc: Generates a non-disclosure agreement for a named party, mutual or one-way, with the purpose, term and governing law filled in.
